name: Mitten Extracts Disposable 2-In-1 Flip | Peach Rings Gelato + Watermelon Z
description:
Juicy peach candy flavor meets sweet watermelon goodness. This fruity pairing delivers bright, refreshing flavor whether you enjoy them solo or combine both for a candy-inspired blend.

2 Grams. Two flavors. Three modes. Total control - Flavor for taste, Balance for smooth hits, Clouds for max output.
